criteria.statement: A pre/post rollout policy hash mismatch, older event, or empty projection fails the deployment health gate and invokes rollback; the same valid event or a canonically newer event succeeds.
Production Compose deployment accepts only immutable digest references and backend/web images carry OCI source, revision, and version metadata.
Backup export and approved restore preserve the canonical public signed payload plus event ID, hash, author, event/acceptance timestamps, schema, source, and sync provenance.
Restored policy is cached last-known-good, not live, until relay confirmation of the same signed event or a canonically newer event.
Backend restart or image replacement hydrates the durable last-known-good policy and reports structured projection readiness while the canonical relay is unavailable.
No credential, private key, credential-bearing relay URL, query token, or fragment is emitted in health evidence or projection backup data; restore mutation stays signer-first and approval-gated.
